title: Alternatives: Swarm, Nomad, ECS and PaaS — when Kubernetes is overkill

videos.script: Lesson 1 ended with a list of things one machine cannot do. Kubernetes does all of them. So do several other tools, and some of them cost far less to run. {{list}} This lesson puts four of them beside Kubernetes. Docker's own Swarm mode. HashiCorp's Nomad. Amazon's ECS. And the platforms where you hand over an image and never see a machine at all. {{four}} The question for each one is the same. Who runs the part that decides? And what do you give up in exchange? {{who}} Then comes the harder question, the one this course has to be honest about. When is Kubernetes more machinery than the problem needs? {{overkill}} By the end you should be able to argue against this course, for a team that does not need it. {{argue}}
